inv.desc_en:
Are you looking for a space to attend to your clients with calm, aesthetics, and professionalism?

We offer you a fully equipped cabin, ideal for:

♀️ Estheticians? Micropigmentation artists
♀️ Cosmetologists? ♂️ Physiotherapists? Or any wellness professional who needs an intimate and well-maintained space.

✨ Includes:
Professional stretcher
Sink
Adjustable warm light
Auxiliary furniture
Air conditioning
Zen atmosphere, decorated with natural and relaxing aesthetics
Access to common areas (bathroom, reception, waiting room).
